name: MiaraOS
description: MiaraOS (branded "Miara" on its website) is a calm, private baby-care log for feeds, diapers, sleep, growth and first foods, shared with everyone who cares for the baby. Logging takes a tap, or a sentence to Siri, Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini. Optional AI insights turn the log into plain-language notes on what is changing.
facts: Native SwiftUI iOS app with home-screen widget, Lock Screen and Dynamic Island live activities
Conversational logging through Siri/Shortcuts and a remote MCP server for Claude and ChatGPT (site also lists Gemini)
Shared households with roles: parents, caregivers and viewers; every record shows who added or changed it
Trends, a 24-hour timeline, a week view and WHO growth percentiles
First-foods "rainbow" toward 100 foods, with allergen tracking
Opt-in AI insights written by Claude; no ads or tracking
App Store listing prepared ("MiaraOS: Baby Care & Sleep Log", Health & Fitness); no public App Store listing found yet
Repo started Oct 2026

name: Semester.ly
description: Semester.ly is a course-scheduling platform Noah co-founded as a Johns Hopkins student. It builds conflict-free schedules and shows course ratings, reviews, textbooks and which friends are in each class. It launched at Hopkins in October 2015, spread to universities in the U.S. and Canada, and was open-sourced in 2017. The live site is now maintained by JHU Open Source.
facts: Co-founded with Rohan Das and Felix Zhu (University of Toronto); launched at Johns Hopkins on Oct 26, 2015
Over 1,000 Hopkins users in its first 24 hours (JHU News-Letter, 2017)
More than 26,000 users across three universities about a year after launch (JHU Hub, 2016)
More than two million searches and nearly a dozen universities, among them UMD, Queen's, GWU, Michigan and Salisbury (JHU News-Letter, 2017)
Open-sourced in 2017 under GPL v3; more than 30 student contributors
Noah is the top contributor to the original repo (1,299 commits); 94 stars and 184 forks
The original repo was deprecated in June 2021 and active development moved to github.com/jhuopensource/semesterly
The live site currently lists Johns Hopkins and the Costa Rica Institute of Technology

name: NameWise
tagline: Find the name that feels like home.
description: NameWise is an AI baby-name assistant for couples. It learns a family's style, heritage and story, then deals out personalized name cards to swipe through. When both partners love the same name, it lights up as a match, and family can be invited to swipe privately too.
facts: Swipe-to-match: partners swipe independently and mutual likes become matches, with push notifications
Personalized onboarding on style, cultural roots and feel before the first name is suggested
Name library, middle-name pairing, notes, and private family swiping
iOS app is a Capacitor shell around the live site (bundle me.presler.namewise); App Store screenshots are prepared, but no public listing was found
Light and dark (night) themes
Repo started Feb 2026

name: WeWatch
description: WeWatch is a cinematic, AI-curated watchlist for couples and households. Each partner seeds their taste, and Claude blends both into weekly personalized recommendations. A shared Watched library, a drag-to-reorder Watch List and a Coming Soon feed show where every title is streaming.
facts: Household-scoped: link two accounts with an invite code; recommendations blend both partners' tastes
Weekly batch refresh through Vercel cron jobs, plus rate-limited on-demand refresh
Title cards show IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes scores, NEW and NEW SEASON tags and streaming-service badges
Tabs for For You, Watched (Loved, Liked, Meh, Disliked), a drag-to-reorder Watch List and Coming Soon
Native SwiftUI iOS app (Liquid Glass) and an Android app share the same API; no public store listing found
Repo started Apr 2026
